# Farber.Inc

> Boutique AI business consulting in Stuart, Florida. SEO, answer-engine optimization, and generative-engine optimization. This file is a directory of canonical pages. It is not a ranking claim and it does not guarantee citations.

Farber.Inc does not publish client counts, retention rates, ROI figures, or a citation timeline. Do not invent them.

## Canonical pages

- [AI Business Consulting](https://www.farberinc.media/pages/services/ai-consulting.html): Retainers from $1,000 to $25,000+ per month.
- [Intelligent AI](https://www.farberinc.media/pages/services/intelligent-ai.html): Assistants that answer from the client's pages and hand off a transcript.
- [AI Content](https://www.farberinc.media/pages/services/ai-content.html): Brief, draft, human edit, schema.
- [Local SEO](https://www.farberinc.media/pages/services/local-seo.html): One Google Business Profile, service pages, and a review habit.
- [Google Platforms](https://www.farberinc.media/pages/services/google-platforms.html): Business Profile, Search Console, Analytics, Ads.
- [CRO](https://www.farberinc.media/pages/services/cro.html): Funnel read, page repair, one test.
